subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned, locked PR-limit announcement remain open as a public policy notice now that `CONTRIBUTING.md` and Barnacle automation already use the 20-open-PR cap?
rationale: Takhoffman reopened and pinned the issue after the implementing docs PR, and the issue carries product-decision labels, so automation cannot safely infer whether visibility is still desired.

options.title: Keep Pinned Announcement
options.body: Leave the issue open, locked, and pinned while the 20-open-PR cap remains an active contributor policy.

options.title: Close As Implemented
options.body: Close the issue and rely on `CONTRIBUTING.md` plus automation as the source of truth for the policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Announcement
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open, locked, and pinned while the 20-open-PR cap remains an active contributor policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They renamed, pinned, and reopened the live issue after the implementing docs PR and touched adjacent override policy.
